Import and export dozens of formats (STEP, IGES, CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, Creo, JT, IFC, FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, USD, and many more). Run unity transform sdk install first. Currently an internal alpha, not yet publicly available.

items.name: transform
items.description: Convert, optimize, and inspect CAD and 3D models from the command line with the Asset Transformer SDK: tessellate, decimate, remove hidden geometry, build LODs, take screenshots, and run Python scripts in long-lived sessions. Import and export dozens of formats (STEP, IGES, CATIA, SolidWorks, NX, Creo, JT, IFC, FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, USD, and many more). Run unity transform sdk install first. Currently an internal alpha, not yet publicly available.

items.name: assetlibrary
items.description: Find Asset Store content from the command line by text or image, inspect it, and import its source files into a Unity project, download them to any folder, or build a .unitypackage signed for your organization, using your Unity sign-in. Check its status with unity assetlibrary doctor. Currently an internal alpha, not yet publicly available.
